$sources: windows/Source/MuseeVision/SunClock/SunClockGlyphs.h, baked by windows/Source/MuseeVision/SunClock/bake_glyphs.py from Centaur (Bruce Rogers, 1914, after Nicolas Jenson; C:/Windows/Fonts/CENTAUR.TTF), the Windows face closest to the Trajan inscription: quadratic curves flattened within 1/600 of the cap height, contours wound with the solid on the left, triangulated once, mitres checked against turning over for bevels up to 0.016 cap. Ported point for point (Docs/Stages/rotunda.md section 3.1: the motto's glyphs port the as-built outlines; no download). A public release switches to an open-licence face.

$records.source: Centaur capitals A E H I M N O R S U V X, for HORAS NON NUMERO NISI SERENAS and the hour numerals, from the as-built sun clock's bake (SunClockGlyphs.h).
